mechanism: Duloxetine inhibits serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake while sacubitril (neprilysin inhibitor) increases natriuretic peptide levels, creating additive hypotensive effects and potential serotonergic modulation through neprilysin's role in serotonin metabolism.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; dose adjustment of duloxetine may be needed; counsel patient on orthostatic hypotension risk and ensure adequate renal function monitoring.
